The '''59th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2006, were presented on February 3, 2007, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Names Winners and Special Award Recipients at 59th Annual DGA Awards|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2007/0204-DGA-Names-Winners-and-Special-Award-Recipients-at-59th-Annual-DGA-Awards.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=February 4, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=Directors Guild honors Scorsese|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2007-feb-04-me-dga4-story.html|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=February 4, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=DGA Awards winners|url=https://variety.com/2007/film/awards/dga-awards-winners-1117958441/|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Variety|date=February 3, 2007}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Carl Reiner]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Sets Host and Presenters for 59th Annual DGA Awards Dinner|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2007/0130-DGA-Sets-Host-and-Presenters-for-59th-Annual-DGA-Awards-Dinner.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 30, 2007}}</ref> On January 9, 2007, the nominees in the feature film category were announced<ref>{{cite web|title=Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Feature Film for the Year 2006|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2007/0109-Nominees-for-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-in-Feature-Film-for-the-Year-2006.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 9, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Fresh faces for DGA nominations|url=https://variety.com/2007/film/awards/fresh-faces-for-dga-nominations-1117956982/|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 9, 2007}}</ref> and on January 10, 2007, the nominations in the television movie category were announced.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Movies for Television for the Year 2006|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2007/0110-Nominees-for-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-in-Movies-for-Television-for-the-Year-2006.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 10, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA nominates TV movies|url=https://variety.com/2007/film/awards/dga-nominates-tv-movies-1117957095/|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 10, 2007}}</ref> The nominations for the remaining six television awards were announced on January 11, 2007,<ref>{{cite web|title=Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television: Dramatic Series Night, Comedy Series, Musical Variety, Reality Programs, Daytime Serials and Children's Programs|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2007/0111-Nominees-for-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-in-Television.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 11, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA nominates TV favorites|url=https://variety.com/2007/film/awards/dga-nominates-tv-favorites-1117957187/|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 11, 2007}}</ref> and the nominations for directorial achievement in documentaries and commercials were announced on January 16, 2007.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Documentary and Commercials for 2006|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2007/0116-Nominees-for-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-in-Documentary-and-Commercials.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 16, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA nominates documentaries|url=https://variety.com/2007/film/awards/dga-nominates-documentaries-1117957496/|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 16, 2007}}</ref>
